scenarios.title: 39.8 deg of Sun change: the verdict refuses, and draws nothing
scenarios.why: The same ground at incidence 29.95 deg and 69.76 deg. Long shadows change what the surface looks like; the system must say REJECTED and withhold the registered image rather than draw a plausible-looking wrong alignment.

scenarios.title: Cross-mission: an LRO NAC frame onto a Kaguya (JAXA) ortho map
scenarios.why: Different agency, spacecraft, camera and decade; the Kaguya map is controlled by its own network and photometrically normalised. The pixel-size ratio between the two uploads is about 2:1 after the card's own down-sampling.
